env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Defaults fill fields provided by neither a spread nor an explicit value.
# Composite defaults stay fresh and every spread source runs exactly once.
cd m
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_defaults.lgo main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/spread_defaults.out expected.txt
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/spreaddefaults

go 1.27
